meta.title: Rebuttal — VRR Refusal (demand for OIC, evidence link, VPS)

content.subject: Re: Sussex Police - IX/619/25 — VRR refusal challenged; request for OIC, VPS and evidence submission link
content.body:
Dear Professional Standards Department and Inspector Palmer,

I respond to your email of 22/26 August 2025 declaring my VRR application invalid.

You state 47240214305 is 'live and ongoing' with a suspect linked. If so, enable evidence submission: please arrange a NICE link. You also rely on 'associated master case' to deny VRR for 47240141246 (NFA). That is contradictory: if the case is open, I must be allowed to submit evidence; if closed, I am entitled to VRR. It cannot be both.

I require:
• The name, rank and contact details of the officer in charge (OIC). 
• A timeframe for contact.
• Immediate provision to make my Victim Personal Statement (VPS).

Safeguarding: I have made 45 calls to 101/999 with promised callbacks and none received. I have had no officer contact since 6 April 2025. I attach screenshots and CAD evidence. This obstruction is before the ICO (accuracy/processing) and IOPC (conduct).

I expect a substantive response based on law, not procedural deflection.

Yours sincerely,
Ben Carter
